If the service is OFF and it is not listed in Settings > Accessibility, enable it from a computer:

adb shell settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services com.rajat.fireremote.tv/com.rajat.fireremote.tv.RemoteAccessibilityService
adb shell settings put secure accessibility_enabled 1
